chapterInfo.content:
1
Onyankopɔn nam Kristo so kasa
1Onyankopɔn a tete no ɔnam mmerɛ ahodoɔ ne akwan ahodoɔ so, nam adiyifoɔ so kasa kyerɛɛ agyanom no, 2#Dwom 2.8; Yoh 1.3; Kol 1.16 nna a ɛdi akyire yi mu nso, ɔnam Ɔba no so akasa akyerɛ yɛn. Ɔno na wayɛ no nnoɔma nyinaa ɔdedifoɔ, a ɔnam ne so nso abɔ wiase nyinaa. 3#2 Ko 4.4; Kol 1.15; Heb 9.14; 9.26; Mar 16.19 Ɔno ara a ɔyɛ n’animuonyam no haran ne ne su nsɛsoɔ, na ɔde ne tumi asɛm sɔ nnoɔma nyinaa mu no, ɔde ɔno ara ne ho dwiraa yɛn bɔne no, ɔkɔtenaa animuonyam kɛseɛ no nifa so ɔsorosoro, 4#Flp 2.9 na wakyɛne abɔfoɔ no mmoroso, sɛdeɛ ne din kunini a wanya no kyɛne wɔn deɛ no.
Kristo yɛ Nyankopɔn ba, na abɔfoɔ yɛ n’asomfoɔ
5 # Dwom 2.7; 2 Sa 7.14 Na abɔfoɔ mu hwan na waka akyerɛ no pɛn sɛ:
Me ba ne wo,
me na mawo wo nnɛ,
na bio:
Mɛyɛ no Agya,
na ɔno nso ayɛ me ɔba?
6 # Rom 8.29; Dwom 97.7 Na ɔnya de abakan no ba wiase bio a, ɔse:
Ma Nyankopɔn abɔfoɔ nyinaa nsɔre no!
7 # Dwom 104.4 Na abɔfoɔ no ho deɛ, ɔse:
Ɔyɛ n’abɔfoɔ mframa
ne n’asomfoɔ, ogyaframa,
8 # Dwom 45.6-7 na ɔba no ho deɛ, ɔse:
Onyankopɔn, w’ahennwa wɔ hɔ daapem daapem,
w’ahennie poma yɛ poma a ɛtene.
9Wodɔ tenenee, na wokyiri amumuyɛ
enti na Onyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn,
de ahosan ngo asra woɔ asene wo mfɛfoɔ.
10 # Dwom 102.25-27 Na:
Awurade, mfitiaseɛ no, wotoo asase fapem,
na wo nsa ano nnwuma ne ɔsoro.
11Yeinom bɛsɛe, nanso wo deɛ, wowɔ hɔ ara,
na ne nyinaa bɛsu sɛ atadeɛ,
12na wobɛbobɔ wɔn sɛ firatam,
na wɔasakyera wɔn sɛ atadeɛ.
Na wo deɛ, wote sɛ deɛ wote ara,
na wo mfeɛ renhi da.
13 # Dwom 110.1 Na abɔfoɔ no mu hwan ho na waka pɛn sɛ:
Tena me nifa so
kɔsi sɛ mede w’atamfo bɛyɛ wo nan ase ntiasoɔ?
14 # Dan 7.10; Dwom 34.7; 91.11 Wɔn nyinaa nyɛ ahonhom asomfoɔ a, wɔn a, wɔbɛyɛ nkwagyeɛ no adedifoɔ no nti, wɔsoma wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔsom no anaa?

pageProps.chapterText:
Onyankopɔn a tete no ɔnam mmerɛ ahodoɔ ne akwan ahodoɔ so, nam adiyifoɔ so kasa kyerɛɛ agyanom no, nna a ɛdi akyire yi mu nso, ɔnam Ɔba no so akasa akyerɛ yɛn. Ɔno na wayɛ no nnoɔma nyinaa ɔdedifoɔ, a ɔnam ne so nso abɔ wiase nyinaa. Ɔno ara a ɔyɛ n’animuonyam no haran ne ne su nsɛsoɔ, na ɔde ne tumi asɛm sɔ nnoɔma nyinaa mu no, ɔde ɔno ara ne ho dwiraa yɛn bɔne no, ɔkɔtenaa animuonyam kɛseɛ no nifa so ɔsorosoro, na wakyɛne abɔfoɔ no mmoroso, sɛdeɛ ne din kunini a wanya no kyɛne wɔn deɛ no.

Na abɔfoɔ mu hwan na waka akyerɛ no pɛn sɛ:
Me ba ne wo,
me na mawo wo nnɛ,
na bio:
Mɛyɛ no Agya,
na ɔno nso ayɛ me ɔba?
Na ɔnya de abakan no ba wiase bio a, ɔse:
Ma Nyankopɔn abɔfoɔ nyinaa nsɔre no!
Na abɔfoɔ no ho deɛ, ɔse:
Ɔyɛ n’abɔfoɔ mframa
ne n’asomfoɔ, ogyaframa,
na ɔba no ho deɛ, ɔse:
Onyankopɔn, w’ahennwa wɔ hɔ daapem daapem,
w’ahennie poma yɛ poma a ɛtene.
Wodɔ tenenee, na wokyiri amumuyɛ
enti na Onyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn,
de ahosan ngo asra woɔ asene wo mfɛfoɔ.
Na:
Awurade, mfitiaseɛ no, wotoo asase fapem,
na wo nsa ano nnwuma ne ɔsoro.
Yeinom bɛsɛe, nanso wo deɛ, wowɔ hɔ ara,
na ne nyinaa bɛsu sɛ atadeɛ,
na wobɛbobɔ wɔn sɛ firatam,
na wɔasakyera wɔn sɛ atadeɛ.
Na wo deɛ, wote sɛ deɛ wote ara,
na wo mfeɛ renhi da.
Na abɔfoɔ no mu hwan ho na waka pɛn sɛ:
Tena me nifa so
kɔsi sɛ mede w’atamfo bɛyɛ wo nan ase ntiasoɔ?
Wɔn nyinaa nyɛ ahonhom asomfoɔ a, wɔn a, wɔbɛyɛ nkwagyeɛ no adedifoɔ no nti, wɔsoma wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔsom no anaa?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
